title: Each component copy has its own state

slides.say: Render the same component twice. Does it share state? No.
Each Gallery here has completely isolated state. Click next in one, and the other does not move.

slides.text: State belongs to a place on the screen, not to the function or the module.
slides.say: That is the difference from a variable at the top of your module. State is local to a specific place on the screen.

slides.text: State is private: Page can’t read or change Gallery’s state. To sync them, lift state to the parent.
slides.say: And it is private. The parent cannot read or change it. To keep two copies in sync, move the state up to their closest shared parent.
